criteria.evidence: Turn 0: second-revision dir is 'the negative side' the mirror must not copy, tied to folder_sync._snap_sync_exclude_filters and the §6 ls check on pc2.
Turns 4-5 literally ran `ssh pc1 ...` → 'ssh: command not found', said VMs unreachable, and reasoned from flatpak_sync.py / removed _filter_denies / ADR-020 measurements.
Turn 1/6: 'Bug — in the runbook fixture, not the tool' because allow-only filter denies nothing so _abort_on_a_source_filter_that_denies_its_own_apps finds the app offered.
Turn 7: 'Expected — but the runbook's §3 preamble over-claims'.

Diff §3 preamble: 'The first two end it before any question at all; the third ... the /opt shape question comes first'; check 3 text describes question then abort; runbook-fix choice stated in turn 8.
Diff §4: 'the collateral question `<y>`, whose answer reads `remove`' replacing "go ahead".
Diff §4: repository deletion `<s>` 'which apt_sync puts in a review round of its own once the first round's answers are in'.
Diff §4/§5: 'Install snap packages with hello-world left at install' placed after repo deletion, before Change snap packages.
Diff §4/§5: 'flatpak_sync's one screen, Install flatpak applications, with io.github.fragglet.sdl_sopwith left at install' between snap screens and /opt question.
Turn 12 explanation and diff §4 clause 'nothing on disk settles it ... this runbook takes the shallower one, which is what makes /opt/pcsw-uat-vendor the single finding §5 and §6 expect'.
Diff §4: 'one item per screen, in path order ... /opt/pcsw-uat-app answered <y> ... and then /opt/pcsw-uat-vendor answered <x>'.
Turn 15: snapd auto-refresh on pc2 since _hold_snap_autorefresh returns early under --dry-run; VMs unreachable so gave check commands.
Turn 15: `ssh testuser@"$PC2" 'sudo snap refresh --revision=<that second revision> hello && snap list hello'` before re-running.
Diff §4: 'Re-apply pc2's hello revision before each of these runs' with the ssh/snap refresh command and rationale.
Only the runbook markdown changed; replay reports 'codespell clean' after each edit; no source file touched so ruff/basedpyright/pytest not required.

judge.reason: Every divergence was diagnosed with a stated verdict and the runbook diff corrects the filter, §3 preamble/check 3, collateral key, 'second round', the two missing install screens, the one-application justification, the review order, and the per-run hello re-pin. Doubt remains on c2 since the replay initially asked the user to run commands before attempting ssh itself, though it did attempt ssh, reported unreachability and reasoned from code as the criterion allows.
